cache_scope: content-free source-cache counters and gauges from the public PPTX diagnostics API; unavailable states are explicit; untimed evidence only with no latency, allocator, RSS, or cache-efficiency claim
budget_scope: independent source and destination managed Budget roots; Memory and Objects are releasable gauges while InputBytes, OutputBytes, and Work are cumulative charges
source_io_scope: InstrumentedSource positional read_calls/read_bytes atomics; logical source reads only, with no physical-storage or decompression attribution
publication_scope: source-backed PPTX cross-copy exact output and consuming destination-editor boundary; output is an oracle, not a latency measurement
rss_scope: optional process-wide VmRSS/VmHWM snapshots from procfs; probe overhead and unrelated process memory remain in scope

phases.label: baseline
phases.live_owners: fixed corpus and caller budget only; cache owner is not opened

phases.label: metadata
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation, selected slide metadata, caller source Arc, and budget

phases.label: payload
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation, selected image or publication owner, returned payload handles when admitted, and caller source Arc

phases.label: drop_image
phases.live_owners: source-backed presentation and caller source Arc after returned image handle scope ends

phases.label: drop_view
phases.live_owners: caller source Arc after the public source-view diagnostic owner ends

phases.label: opened_1
phases.live_owners: first repeated-publication destination editor and shared caller sources

phases.label: planned_1
phases.live_owners: first repeated-publication plan, source view, destination editor, and shared caller sources

phases.label: published_1
phases.live_owners: first publication result, source view, plan, sink, and shared caller sources; editor consumed

phases.label: drop_plan_1
phases.live_owners: first repeated-publication source view, shared caller sources, and destination sink scope

phases.label: drop_sink_1
phases.live_owners: first repeated-publication source view and shared caller sources after sink drop
